newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fdlot cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fdlot cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the panhandle area Monday, USDA said.

Not enough slaughter steers and heifers confirmed for a market test. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 900 head slaughter steers; 24,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,400 formulated and 700 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 65.00.
Confirmed: 900 Week Ago: 1,100 Year Ago: None
Wk to Date: 24,000 Week Ago: 25,500 Year Ago: None
